title: 读懂实验室生物安全手册
source_doc: course/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/33_WORLD HEALTH ORGANIZATION LABORATORY BIOSAFETY MANUAL.md
author_source: project/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/33_WORLD HEALTH ORGANIZATION LABORATORY BIOSAFETY MANUAL/src.py

points.K1: 一部手册，作为参照起点
points.K2: 手册在本国法律内实施
points.K8: 多数人在二级三级工作
points.K13: 三级实验室：负压和气闸
points.K14: 风险组不等于实验室级别
points.S2: 高致病性菌毒种运输，先审批
points.S3: 出了事，逐级报告别隐瞒

shots.scene: 欣欣站在书架前，手里捧着一本厚厚的空白手册
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a bookshelf holding a thick blank manual and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，我们来读懂一部手册。
overlay: 读懂实验室生物安全手册

shots.scene: 手册封面是一个生物危害标志图标，旁边分出九个小标签
shots.prompt_en: A thick manual with a biohazard warning sign on the cover, nine small tabs fanning out from it. No people.
shots.narration: 一部实验室生物安全手册，共九部分。

shots.scene: 阿杰对着厚手册发愁，头上一堆问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks overwhelmed by the thick manual, question marks above his head.
shots.narration: 阿杰翻开手册：这么厚，从哪看起？

shots.scene: 小研拍拍他肩膀，指向书架上一本薄本子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pats his shoulder and points at a thin booklet on the shelf.
shots.narration: 小研说：它是参照，关键要落到本地。

shots.scene: 王老师在白板上写下三个字：安全、安保、责任
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator writes three blank keyword cards on a whiteboard: safety, security, responsibility.
shots.narration: 王老师说：安全、安保，是大家的事。

shots.section_title: 一部手册，作为参照起点
shots.scene: 欣欣把厚手册摆在桌子中央，当作参照底板
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot places the thick manual at the center of a desk as a reference base.
shots.narration: 这部手册，是一个很好的参照起点。
overlay: 一部手册，作为参照起点

shots.section_title: 一部手册，作为参照起点
shots.scene: 手册旁边放着一本空白的本机构手册等待填写
shots.prompt_en: Next to the manual lies a blank institutional handbook waiting to be filled in. No people.
shots.narration: 每个实验室，都要据它编自己的手册。

shots.section_title: 手册在本国法律内实施
shots.scene: 手册上方压着一本国徽式样的法律书
shots.prompt_en: The manual with a law book bearing an official emblem resting on top of it. No people.
shots.narration: 用它，得在本国法律的框架里。
overlay: 手册在本国法律内实施

shots.section_title: 手册在本国法律内实施
shots.scene: 天平一端手册，一端法律书，法律书略重
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with the manual on one side and the national law book slightly heavier on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 国家和地方法规优先，手册作补充。

shots.scene: 许多双手一起托起一个地球和实验室图标
shots.prompt_en: Many hands together lift up a globe and a lab building icon. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全不是某一家的事，

shots.scene: 多个实验室图标用链条连成一圈
shots.prompt_en: Several lab building icons linked into a ring by a chain. No people.
shots.narration: 是每个国家、每个实验室共同的责任。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一张空白成绩单，列着三行
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank checklist with three rows.
shots.narration: 学完这一课，你应该能做到：

shots.scene: 三个图标：原则书、四格色块、空白手册
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a principles book, four colored blocks, and a blank handbook. No people.
shots.narration: 讲清原则、说出四个级别、编本地手册。

shots.scene: 厚手册摊开，书脊分出九个彩色标签
shots.prompt_en: The thick manual lies open, its spine split into nine colored tabs. No people.
shots.narration: 整部手册，分成九个部分。

shots.scene: 第一个标签亮起，写着一般原则
shots.prompt_en: The first tab lights up, labeled with a shield pictogram for general principles. No people.
shots.narration: 第一部分，是生物安全的一般原则。

shots.scene: 四个格子由绿到红排开，上方一个国际地球图标
shots.prompt_en: Four boxes shaded from green to red under a globe icon representing an international organization.
shots.narration: 先看四个风险组，由低到高。

shots.scene: 单人和三人图标分别标在格子上，颜色递进
shots.prompt_en: Single-person and three-person icons marked on the boxes, colors deepening across them. No people.
shots.narration: 看个人风险，也看群体风险。

shots.scene: 上排国际格子由浅到深，下排国内格子由深到浅，箭头交叉
shots.prompt_en: Two rows of four boxes shaded in opposite directions, linked by crossing arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 注意：国内分类方向正好相反。

shots.scene: 小研翻开空白目录书逐行核对
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank catalogue book and checks a row with her finger.
shots.narration: 具体第几类，查国家病原目录。

shots.scene: 四级台阶，每级一个实验室门图标，越高越严
shots.prompt_en: Four ascending steps, each with a lab door icon, locks increasing with height. No people.
shots.narration: 再看四个生物安全水平，一到四级。

shots.scene: 每级门旁一份SOP和一张工程图纸
shots.prompt_en: Beside each door step, an SOP document and an engineering blueprint. No people.
shots.narration: 级别靠管理规程和工程设计来保障。

shots.scene: 一个动物图标前缀A，一个加号表示增强
shots.prompt_en: A door icon prefixed with the letter A beside an animal icon, and another door with a plus sign. No people.
shots.narration: 动物设施加A，加号表示增强型。

shots.scene: 欣欣提示：国内级别方向与国际一致
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at four matching door steps in both rows, same direction.
shots.narration: 级别一到四，国内外方向一致。

shots.section_title: 多数人在二级三级工作
shots.scene: 二级和三级两扇门被高亮，人影较多
shots.prompt_en: The second and third lab door steps are highlighted, with many small worker silhouettes. No people shown in detail.
shots.narration: 我们大多数人，在二级三级工作。
overlay: 多数人在二级三级工作

shots.section_title: 多数人在二级三级工作
shots.scene: 四级门外加一圈额外的锁和维护齿轮
shots.prompt_en: The fourth-level door with an extra ring of locks and maintenance gears around it. No people.
shots.narration: 四级很特殊，维护和监管要求很高。

shots.scene: 王老师和几位同事围桌制定一张空白规范清单
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and several colleagues around a table drafting a blank code-of-practice list.
shots.narration: 建实验室第一步：定行为规范。

shots.scene: 清单上列着最基本的操作条目图标
shots.prompt_en: A list with icons of the most essential laboratory practices. No people.
shots.narration: 把最基本的操作一条条写清楚。

shots.scene: 管理层和各岗位代表一起签字
shots.prompt_en: Management and representatives from each role sign the list together. No people shown in detail.
shots.narration: 由管理层会同各方一起制定。

shots.scene: 一张空白评估表，列着病原相关的几行
shots.prompt_en: A blank microbiological risk assessment form with several pathogen-related rows. No people.
shots.narration: 评估微生物风险，要问很多项：

shots.scene: 致病性、暴露可能和后果三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: pathogenicity, likelihood of exposure, and consequence. No people.
shots.narration: 致病性有多强，暴露概率和后果，

shots.scene: 呼吸道和皮肤刺入两个感染途径图标
shots.prompt_en: Two route-of-infection icons: a respiratory route and a skin-puncture route. No people.
shots.narration: 自然感染途径，是吸入还是刺入，

shots.scene: 环境中微生物逐渐变淡，表示稳定性
shots.prompt_en: A microbe icon fading over time in an environment, showing stability. No people.
shots.narration: 在环境里能存活多久，

shots.scene: 培养皿和液体培养瓶，旁边一个量的刻度
shots.prompt_en: A petri dish and a liquid culture flask with a volume scale beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 浓度和培养量有多大，

shots.scene: 病原连到一个宿主图标，再问既往动物研究
shots.prompt_en: A microbe icon linked to a host icon, next to an animal study report. No people.
shots.narration: 有没有合适宿主，有无既往研究，

shots.scene: 地图上预防和治疗图标，一个打勾一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A map with a prevention icon checked and a treatment icon questioned. No people.
shots.narration: 本地能不能预防和治疗。

shots.scene: 一个大圆环里套着多个管理图标
shots.prompt_en: A large ring enclosing many management icons: a door, PPE, an SOP, a building. No people.
shots.narration: 行为规范管的是全面的行政控制：

shots.scene: 准入门、个人防护、操作规范三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an access door, PPE, and an SOP. No people.
shots.narration: 准入、个人防护、操作规范，

shots.scene: 设施设计、设备、健康监护三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: facility design, equipment, and a health check-up. No people.
shots.narration: 设施、设备、健康监护，

shots.scene: 一个带裂纹的心情图标和一个减压图标
shots.prompt_en: A stressed-mood icon with a crack beside a stress-relief icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还包括工作人员的心理和压力。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一张二级实验室平面图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a floor plan of a biosafety level 2 laboratory.
shots.narration: 来看二级实验室怎么布局。

shots.scene: 门口一台高压灭菌器，旁边清晰的标识牌
shots.prompt_en: An autoclave near the entrance with a clear biohazard warning sign beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 入口放高压灭菌器，废物集中灭菌。

shots.scene: 安全淋浴和三种颜色的分类废物桶
shots.prompt_en: A safety shower and three color-coded waste bins for different wastes. No people.
shots.narration: 配安全淋浴，废物按类分桶。

shots.scene: 房间尽端的生物安全柜和通风柜，硬管通向屋顶
shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet and a fume hood at the far end of the room, hard-ducted to the ceiling. No people.
shots.narration: 柜子放尽端，硬管经高效过滤排出。

shots.scene: 气流箭头从操作台被拉向尽端的柜子
shots.prompt_en: Airflow arrows drawn from the workbench toward the cabinet at the far end. No people.
shots.narration: 气流把污染拉向柜子，保护操作者。

shots.section_title: 三级实验室：负压和气闸
shots.scene: 三级实验室平面图，门口多出一个前室
shots.prompt_en: A floor plan of a biosafety level 3 lab with an extra vestibule at the entrance. No people.
shots.narration: 三级实验室，多了几道讲究。
overlay: 三级实验室：负压和气闸

shots.section_title: 三级实验室：负压和气闸
shots.scene: 室内一个向下的压力表，箭头指向负压
shots.prompt_en: A pressure gauge inside the room pointing to negative pressure, arrow downward. No people.
shots.narration: 相对外界维持负压，气流定向流动。

shots.section_title: 三级实验室：负压和气闸
shots.scene: 排风口经高效过滤器再排向室外
shots.prompt_en: An exhaust vent passing through a HEPA filter before releasing outside. No people.
shots.narration: 排风都要经高效过滤，再排到室外。

shots.section_title: 三级实验室：负压和气闸
shots.scene: 高压灭菌器移进室内，旁边暖通管道
shots.prompt_en: An autoclave moved inside the room, HVAC ducts beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 灭菌器移进室内，带来暖通新要求。

shots.section_title: 三级实验室：负压和气闸
shots.scene: 入口前室设密码或指纹门禁
shots.prompt_en: A vestibule entrance with a keypad and fingerprint access reader. No people.
shots.narration: 门口设气闸前室，刷卡或指纹进入。

shots.section_title: 三级实验室：负压和气闸
shots.scene: 更衣区图标，再进入负压封闭区
shots.prompt_en: A changing area icon leading into a negative-pressure containment zone. No people.
shots.narration: 先更衣，再进入负压封闭区。

shots.section_title: 三级实验室：负压和气闸
shots.scene: 压力表报警变红，旁边应急预案图标
shots.prompt_en: The pressure gauge alarms and turns red, next to an emergency plan icon. No people.
shots.narration: 压力一掉，就算封闭破坏，启动应急。

shots.section_title: 风险组不等于实验室级别
shots.scene: 左边风险组格子，右边实验室级别台阶，中间一个问号
shots.prompt_en: Risk group boxes on the left, lab-level steps on the right, a question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 风险组，就等于实验室级别吗？
overlay: 风险组不等于实验室级别

shots.section_title: 风险组不等于实验室级别
shots.scene: 问号旁边出现SOP和评估表
shots.prompt_en: Beside the question mark appear an SOP and a risk assessment form. No people.
shots.narration: 原片说：要看各自的管理控制。

shots.scene: 一个高风险病原图标被箭头想拉向低级别实验室，箭头被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A high-risk microbe icon with an arrow trying to move it into a lower-level lab, the arrow crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 但在国内，不能随意降级操作。

shots.scene: 小研翻目录，对照类别和实验活动定级别
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks a catalogue, matching a category and an activity to a lab level. No people.
shots.narration: 查目录、看是什么实验，再定级别。

shots.scene: 高致病性病原图标连到高级别实验室和审批印章
shots.prompt_en: A highly pathogenic microbe icon linked to a high-level lab and an approval stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 高致病性实验，要够级别又经批准。

shots.scene: 手册第二标签亮起，一个上锁的样品柜图标
shots.prompt_en: The manual's second tab lights up, showing a locked sample cabinet icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第二部分，讲实验室生物安保。

shots.scene: 一个病原图标被贴上资产标签，放进保险柜
shots.prompt_en: A microbe icon tagged as an asset, placed into a safe. No people.
shots.narration: 安保里，病原是要看守的资产。

shots.scene: 两个威胁箭头：一个来自内部人员，一个来自外部
shots.prompt_en: Two threat arrows toward the safe: one from an insider icon, one from an outsider icon. No people.
shots.narration: 威胁有两种：内部的，外部的。

shots.scene: 上锁冰箱、监控摄像头、围栏和门禁四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a locked freezer, a CCTV camera, a fence, and an access card reader. No people.
shots.narration: 一层是物理安保：

shots.scene: 一台电脑屏幕上锁，旁边数据上传的云图标
shots.prompt_en: A locked computer screen next to a cloud upload icon with a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 一层是信息安保：清单、共享、上传都有规矩。

shots.scene: 一份空白背景审查表，对应一个新员工图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank background-check form corresponding to a new staff icon. No people.
shots.narration: 人员入职前，还要做背景筛查。

shots.scene: 天平一端是蓄意释放的可能性，一端是后果
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale: likelihood of intentional release on one side, consequence on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 评估蓄意释放：可能性和后果。

shots.scene: 评估后加上一层层安保措施，风险箭头下降
shots.prompt_en: Security layers added after assessment, a risk arrow going down. No people.
shots.narration: 评估之后，用措施把风险降下来。

shots.scene: 旁边压着一本国内标准和法律书
shots.prompt_en: A national standard booklet and a law book beside the assessment. No people.
shots.narration: 还要对照国家标准和法律。

shots.scene: 安保齿轮和安全齿轮并排一起转动
shots.prompt_en: A security gear and a safety gear turning together side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 安保要和安全并行，日常就做。

shots.scene: 一份空白监管链记录，两处签名交接
shots.prompt_en: A blank chain-of-custody record with two handover signatures. No people.
shots.narration: 物料转移，保持书面监管链。

shots.scene: 角色分工表和一个责任印章
shots.prompt_en: A roles-and-responsibilities chart and an accountability stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 分清职责，出了问题能问责。

shots.scene: 手册第三标签亮起，一台生物安全柜图标
shots.prompt_en: The manual's third tab lights up, showing a biological safety cabinet icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第三部分，讲实验室设备。

shots.scene: 柜子图标周围三个盾牌：操作者、环境、样本
shots.prompt_en: A cabinet icon surrounded by three shields: operator, environment, and sample. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全柜，保护操作者、环境和样本。

shots.scene: 柜口冒出被挡住的气溶胶小点和飞溅图标
shots.prompt_en: Aerosol dots and a splash blocked at the cabinet opening. No people.
shots.narration: 挡住操作时产生的气溶胶和飞溅。

shots.scene: 一级柜气流图：空气从前面进，经高效过滤排出
shots.prompt_en: A class 1 cabinet airflow diagram: air enters from the front and exits through a HEPA filter. No people.
shots.narration: 一级柜：空气从外进，过滤后排出。

shots.scene: 小研站在柜前操作，气流把污染带离她
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works at the open front of the cabinet, airflow carrying contamination away from her.
shots.narration: 给操作者基础的保护。

shots.scene: 二级柜图，一部分空气循环，一部分排出
shots.prompt_en: A class 2 cabinet diagram: part of the air recirculates, part is exhausted. No people.
shots.narration: 二级柜：一部分排出，一部分循环。

shots.scene: 高效过滤器剖面，多层滤材捕获颗粒
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section of a HEPA filter with multiple layers trapping particles. No people.
shots.narration: 高效过滤能挡住极细的颗粒。

shots.scene: 一个小颗粒在多层滤网中被逐层拦下
shots.prompt_en: A tiny particle being caught layer by layer in the multi-layer filter. No people.
shots.narration: 多层加慢速，更小的也被拦住。

shots.scene: 柜内操作区，前后两道格栅形成气幕
shots.prompt_en: A cabinet work area with front and rear grilles forming an air curtain. No people.
shots.narration: 进回风格栅形成气幕，双向保护。

shots.scene: 顶部向下的气流箭头罩住工作台
shots.prompt_en: Downward airflow arrows from the top covering the work surface. No people.
shots.narration: 顶上还有下降气流，罩住台面。

shots.scene: 格栅上压着纸和物品的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of paper and items blocking the grille, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 千万别用纸和物品压住格栅。

shots.scene: 柜内只摆必需品，留出气流通道
shots.prompt_en: Only essential items inside the cabinet, leaving airflow paths clear. No people.
shots.narration: 柜内只放必需品，留出通道。

shots.scene: 柜子上贴着一张定期认证合格标签
shots.prompt_en: A periodic certification label stuck on the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 柜子要定期找服务方认证。

shots.scene: 柜子远离门窗和风扇，周围无气流扰动
shots.prompt_en: The cabinet placed away from doors, windows and fans, no air disturbance around. No people.
shots.narration: 摆放要远离气流，周围别有扰动。

shots.scene: 按SOP在柜内做使用前后的去污
shots.prompt_en: Decontamination before and after use inside the cabinet, following an SOP. No people.
shots.narration: 按规程，用前用后都要去污。

shots.scene: 一份维护计划表和大洒溢消毒步骤图标
shots.prompt_en: A maintenance schedule and a large-spill disinfection procedure icon. No people.
shots.narration: 备好维护计划和大洒溢消毒流程。

shots.scene: 手册第四标签亮起，一本操作规程图标
shots.prompt_en: The manual's fourth tab lights up, showing an SOP book icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第四部分，良好微生物操作。

shots.scene: 应急预案封面，列着几种情形图标
shots.prompt_en: An emergency plan cover listing several scenario icons: breach, illness, spill, fire. No people.
shots.narration: 要有应急预案：破坏、发病、洒溢、火。

shots.scene: 消毒剂瓶旁边一个计时沙漏
shots.prompt_en: A disinfectant bottle beside an hourglass timer. No people.
shots.narration: 消毒要用对药剂，等够接触时间。

shots.scene: 一个密封包裹从一个实验室运向另一个
shots.prompt_en: A sealed package traveling from one lab building to another. No people.
shots.narration: 感染性物质要运输时，有讲究。

shots.scene: 包裹上贴着清晰的标签和生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: A package with a clear label and a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 三层包装，防破损、防泄漏、防暴露。

shots.scene: 包裹旁附一张洒溢清理卡，标签写目的地文字
shots.prompt_en: A spill-cleanup card attached to the package, label noting destination language. No people.
shots.narration: 随附洒溢清理卡，标签要看得懂。

shots.scene: 三层包装剖面图：最内是样本管
shots.prompt_en: A triple-packaging cross-section: a sample tube at the very center. No people.
shots.narration: 来看三层包装，从里到外。

shots.scene: 样本管外第一层防水容器，用聚丙烯管
shots.prompt_en: A first waterproof container around the tube, a polypropylene tube. No people.
shots.narration: 第一层防水容器，建议用塑料管。

shots.scene: 管外塞满吸水材料，标注至少吸三倍液量
shots.prompt_en: Absorbent material packed around the container, noted to absorb at least three times the liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 外面填吸水材料，至少吸三倍液量。

shots.scene: 再套一层次级防水容器
shots.prompt_en: A secondary waterproof container around it. No people.
shots.narration: 再套一层防水的次级容器。

shots.scene: 最外是硬纸箱，贴好标签
shots.prompt_en: An outer rigid cardboard box with labels attached. No people.
shots.narration: 最外是硬箱，贴清标签。

shots.section_title: 高致病性菌毒种运输，先审批
shots.scene: 一个深色高致病性样本盒，旁边一个审批印章
shots.prompt_en: A dark-colored highly pathogenic sample box next to an approval stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 高致病性菌毒种和样本运输，
overlay: 高致病性菌毒种运输，先审批

shots.section_title: 高致病性菌毒种运输，先审批
shots.scene: 空白申请表盖章后，才允许用专用容器运输
shots.prompt_en: A blank application form stamped, then a dedicated transport container allowed to move. No people.
shots.narration: 要先按国内规定审批，用专用包装。

shots.section_title: 高致病性菌毒种运输，先审批
shots.scene: 两人交接样本盒并登记，一辆合规运输车
shots.prompt_en: Two people hand over a sample box and log it, a compliant transport vehicle nearby. No people shown in detail.
shots.narration: 专人押运、登记交接，全程留痕。

shots.scene: 手册第五标签亮起，一个DNA图标旁一个警示框
shots.prompt_en: The manual's fifth tab lights up, a DNA icon beside a warning border. No people.
shots.narration: 第五部分，讲生物技术的新挑战。

shots.scene: 基因在亲代到子代之间传递，和外来引入两种箭头
shots.prompt_en: Two arrows: a gene passing from parent to offspring, and a gene introduced from outside. No people.
shots.narration: 基因有的代代相传，有的被引入。

shots.scene: 一个改造过的微生物图标被红框和打叉标出
shots.prompt_en: A modified microbe icon marked with a red frame and a cross. No people.
shots.narration: 功能获得性实验，许多国家严管或禁止。

shots.scene: 一个良性图标旁一个问号，表示可能被两用
shots.prompt_en: A benign icon beside a question mark, indicating possible dual use. No people.
shots.narration: 良性对象也可能被两用，要警惕。

shots.scene: 小研把方案交给委员会和主管部门审批
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands a plan to a committee and an authority for approval. No people shown in detail.
shots.narration: 这类研究，先评估、报主管部门审批。

shots.scene: 一座冰山，水面上小、水面下大
shots.prompt_en: An iceberg with a small tip above water and a large mass below. No people.
shots.narration: 改造的未知风险，像冰山。

shots.scene: 水面下一个良性图标隐隐变成警示图标
shots.prompt_en: Below the waterline, a benign icon faintly turning into a warning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 良性的，也可能变成潜在的危害。

shots.scene: 欣欣举手提示要以最高谨慎对待
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises a paw urging the highest caution.
shots.narration: 所以要最高谨慎，经批准再做。

shots.scene: 手册第六标签亮起，化学、电、火三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The manual's sixth tab lights up with three icons: chemical, electrical, fire. No people.
shots.narration: 第六部分，化学、电气和消防。

shots.scene: 实验室里一处起火，外部应急人员要进来
shots.prompt_en: A small fire in a lab, external responders about to enter. No people shown in detail.
shots.narration: 一旦出事，外人进来可能破坏封闭。

shots.scene: 一份应急预案和第一响应人培训图标
shots.prompt_en: An emergency plan and a first-responder training icon. No people.
shots.narration: 要提前做预案，培训第一响应人。

shots.scene: 手册第七标签亮起，一张组织架构图
shots.prompt_en: The manual's seventh tab lights up, showing an organization chart. No people.
shots.narration: 第七部分，安全组织与培训。

shots.scene: 架构图顶端是生物安全委员会
shots.prompt_en: At the top of the chart, an institutional biosafety committee box. No people.
shots.narration: 顶端是机构生物安全委员会。

shots.scene: 中间生物安全官和设施经理并肩
shots.prompt_en: In the middle, a biosafety officer and a facility manager side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 中间是生物安全官和设施经理。

shots.scene: 底层技术员、研究人员、保洁等人员图标
shots.prompt_en: At the bottom, icons of technicians, researchers, and cleaners. No people shown in detail.
shots.narration: 底层是技术员、研究和辅助人员。

shots.scene: 一张循环箭头的培训记录，持续进行
shots.prompt_en: A training record with a looping arrow, showing it is ongoing. No people.
shots.narration: 培训不是一次，而是持续进行。

shots.scene: 手册第八标签亮起，一张核对表图标
shots.prompt_en: The manual's eighth tab lights up, showing a checklist icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第八部分，核对表。

shots.scene: 核对表和SOP用箭头连在一起
shots.prompt_en: A checklist linked to an SOP by an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 核对表和操作规程配套使用。

shots.scene: 阿杰操作时逐项打勾，头脑清醒专注
shots.prompt_en: The young male student ticks items one by one while working, focused and alert.
shots.narration: 边做边勾，保持情景意识。

shots.scene: 一个疲劳表情和一个轮班时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A fatigued-face icon and a shift-rotation clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 累了容易出错，长流程要轮班。

shots.scene: 小研在背后帮阿杰核对同一张表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks the same list behind the young male student.
shots.narration: 可以自查，也可以同伴互查。

shots.scene: 核对表存成电子和纸质两份，盖受控章
shots.prompt_en: The checklist stored as both electronic and paper copies, stamped as controlled. No people.
shots.narration: 电子纸质双份存档，审计要查。

shots.section_title: 出了事，逐级报告别隐瞒
shots.scene: 阿杰手套被针尖碰到，立即停下处理
shots.prompt_en: The young male student's glove is nicked by a needle tip; he stops immediately to deal with it. No wound shown.
shots.narration: 万一针刺、溢洒、暴露，先立即处置。
overlay: 出了事，逐级报告别隐瞒

shots.section_title: 出了事，逐级报告别隐瞒
shots.scene: 一条上报箭头：负责人、学院、学校和保卫处
shots.prompt_en: An escalation arrow through icons: lab head, college, school biosafety office and security office. No people.
shots.narration: 再逐级报告负责人、学院和学校。

shots.section_title: 出了事，逐级报告别隐瞒
shots.scene: 一部电话旁写着120，和一本如实记录的本子
shots.prompt_en: A phone showing the digits 120 next to a truthful record book. No people.
shots.narration: 必要时打120，如实记录别隐瞒。

shots.scene: 厚手册旁边，本机构手册被一本本国法律盖章认可
shots.prompt_en: Next to the thick manual, an institutional handbook stamped and endorsed by a national law book. No people.
shots.narration: 总结：手册是基础，要本土化。

shots.scene: 参考文献一摞国外资料被轻轻放到一边
shots.prompt_en: A stack of foreign reference documents set gently to one side. No people.
shots.narration: 参考文献是国外的，只作背景。

shots.scene: 一本本国法律和一本本校手册并排立起
shots.prompt_en: A national law book and an institutional handbook standing side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 一切做法，以国内法规为准。

shots.scene: 两本空白标准册和一本病原目录摆成一排
shots.prompt_en: Two blank standard booklets and a pathogen catalogue in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 通用标准、通用准则、病原目录，

shots.scene: 王老师递给阿杰一本盖章的本校规定
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands the young male student a stamped institutional rulebook.
shots.narration: 再加本校规定，以现行文本为准。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁排着九个标签，一到九依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot beside the nine manual tabs lighting up one to nine.
shots.narration: 九个部分：原则、安保、设备、操作，

shots.scene: 运输、生物技术、化学消防、组织、核对表图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons for transport, biotechnology, chemical/fire safety, organization, and checklists. No people.
shots.narration: 运输、技术、消防、组织和核对表。

shots.scene: 两排方向相反的格子和一本病原目录
shots.prompt_en: Two rows of boxes shaded in opposite directions next to a pathogen catalogue. No people.
shots.narration: 风险组方向相反，定级不降级。

shots.scene: 本国法律盖章的本机构手册立在中央
shots.prompt_en: An institutional handbook stamped by a national law book stands at the center. No people.
shots.narration: 手册作参照，落到本地才算数。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研、阿杰、王老师一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the female graduate student, the young male student and the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 读懂手册，用好规矩，下次见！
